## Experience
- [](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-bare-folder-example/)
- [NCCR SPIN](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/nccr-spin-collaboration/): Research collaboration on advanced spin-based quantum architectures.
- [Coherence Engineering in Semiconductor Spin Qubits](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-invited-talk-eth-zurich/): Invited talk on extending coherence times in Si/SiGe double quantum dots.
- [APS March Meeting 2026](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-aps-march-meeting-2026/): Presented results on spin qubit coherence in Session B42; four days of condensed matter sessions.
- [Hyperfine Noise in Si/SiGe Quantum Dots](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-loss-group-seminar/): Group seminar on nuclear-spin bath dynamics and their effect on gate fidelity.
- [Quantum Information Processing (QIP) 2026](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-qip-2026/): Poster session on gate-fidelity benchmarking for exchange-coupled qubit pairs.
- [Thermodynamic Limits of Reversible Logic](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-contributed-talk-reversible-logic/): Contributed talk on Landauer-limit energy costs in reversible circuit families.
- [KFUPM Physics Colloquium](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-kfupm-colloquium/): Departmental colloquium introducing quantum computing to a general physics audience.
- [Entry With No Kind Set](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-unclassified-example/): This entry deliberately omits `kind:`, so it falls into the 'Other' group at the bottom rather than disappearing.
- [Institute for Quantum Computing, University of Waterloo](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/iqc-waterloo-residency/): Three-month research residency on the evaluation and modelling of fabricated qubits.
- [Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research](http://localhost:1313/my_personal_website/experience/demo-mpi-stuttgart-visit/): Two-week visit to discuss fabrication of isotopically purified heterostructures.
